René Descartes, Philosophical Works, translated by John Veitch.
Standard Ebooks edition: https://standardebooks.org/ebooks/rene-descartes/philosophical-works/john-veitch

People whose words are in the text, and their death years:
- René Descartes, the author, died 1650 (Wikidata Q9191; Wikipedia https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Ren%C3%A9_Descartes).
- John Veitch, the translator, died 1894 (Wikidata Q6261901; Wikipedia https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/John_Veitch_(poet)).

First publication of the text used: between 1850 and 1853, the translation by John Veitch (SE colophon: 'Philosophical Works was compiled from works published between 1637 and 1644 by René Descartes. They were translated from Latin and French between 1850 and 1853 by John Veitch.').

Why this is public domain:
- United States: the text was first published between 1850 and 1853, before 1931. Works published before 1931 are in the United States public domain.
- Country of origin: not needed. Every person named above died in 1925 or earlier, so the text is public domain in every country with a term of life + 100 years or less, whatever its country of first publication.

The edition's own statement of rights (from the repository's content.opf):
"The source text and artwork in this ebook are believed to be in the United States public domain; that is, they are believed to be free of copyright restrictions in the United States. They may still be copyrighted in other countries, so users located outside of the United States must check their local laws before using this ebook. The creators of, and contributors to, this ebook dedicate their contributions to the worldwide public domain via the terms in the [CC0 1.0 Universal Public Domain Dedication](https://creativecommons.org/publicdomain/zero/1.0/)."

Sources of these facts:
- SE colophon: Philosophical Works was compiled from works published between 1637 and 1644 by René Descartes. They were translated from Latin and French between 1850 and 1853 by John Veitch.
- René Descartes: death year 1650 from the gathered facts (Wikidata Q9191; Wikipedia https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Ren%C3%A9_Descartes).
- John Veitch: death year 1894 from the gathered facts (Wikidata Q6261901; Wikipedia https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/John_Veitch_(poet)).
